narr: Southeasterly flow advected in monsoon moisture, fueling scattered thunderstorms, some of which produced flash flooding and severe winds.
ev: Highway 190 was flooded with large flows of water and debris between Cow Creek Road and Salt Creek Road.
Highway 247 was closed south of Barstow due to large amounts of water, debris, and rocks over the road.
Highway 62 was flooded at White Feather Road, Adobe Road, and Encelia Road, where multiple vehicles were trapped in fast moving water. Other secondary roads were also flooded.
Highway 178 was flooded at Pinnacle Road.
National Trails Highway at Nebo Street was blocked by significant water and debris flow.
Three feet of water with mud and rocks covered the intersection of Highways 127 and 190.
lsr: CA-62 flooded at White Feather Road.
CA-62 flooded at Encelia Dr. Multiple vehicles trapped in fast moving water.
CA 62 flooded at Adobe Rd in Twentynine Palms.
CHP reports Flash Flood along SR-178 near Pinnacle Road.
Heavy debris flow reported by NPS between Cow Creek and Salt Creek Roads in Death Valley NP. Roadways impassable due to rock and debris.
Roadway closed at Salt Creek Road due to heavy flooding and debris in roadway per CHP.
Heavy rain in the area, large rocks and debris in the roadway and flooding across the roadway on SR 247 south of Barstow. Traffic being turned around in either direction.
Significant water and debris flow across National Trails Highway and Nebo Street. The roadway was not passable.
CHP reports 3 feet of water flowing over the roadway. Mud and Rocks will need to be cleared with plows. Roadway closed until weather improves.
